Question: What happens when a request carries an expired session token?

The request is rejected with a 401.
validate_session verifies the token and raises SessionExpired when the session is past its expiry [src/miniapp/auth/session.py:L35-L42]. auth_middleware catches SessionExpired and raises Unauthorized [src/miniapp/api/middleware.py:L9-L19]. App.dispatch catches that HttpError and returns a response whose status is 401 [src/miniapp/api/app.py:L22-L33].
